# SKILLSETRA

> SKILLSETRA is an evidence-first competency intelligence project. It connects a target role to required competencies, submitted evidence, review signals, learning actions, assessments and progress tracking.

## Public pages
- https://skillsetra-demo-main-1-nbis.onrender.com/: Product overview and workflow
- https://skillsetra-demo-main-1-nbis.onrender.com/features: Product capabilities
- https://skillsetra-demo-main-1-nbis.onrender.com/how-it-works: Explanation of the evidence loop
- https://skillsetra-demo-main-1-nbis.onrender.com/about: Project purpose and limitations
- https://skillsetra-demo-main-1-nbis.onrender.com/help: Getting started
- https://skillsetra-demo-main-1-nbis.onrender.com/privacy: Privacy information
- https://skillsetra-demo-main-1-nbis.onrender.com/terms: Terms of use
- https://skillsetra-demo-main-1-nbis.onrender.com/contact: Contact information

## Important limitations
AI-generated summaries, suggestions and scores may be incomplete or incorrect. A self-reported claim is not the same as verified evidence. SKILLSETRA does not issue formal credentials or guarantee employment.
